Overview of Community of Madrid Region (Comunidad de Madrid)

Community of Madrid Region (Comunidad de Madrid) is located in the Community of Madrid region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Madrid. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Prado, Reina Sofía & Thyssen-Bornemisza Museums, Royal Palace & Retiro Park, San Lorenzo de El Escorial, Aranjuez & Alcalá de Henares.

RegionCommunity of Madrid
Capital cityMadrid
Cities & municipalities43
Primary transport hubMadrid Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Community of Madrid Region

Madrid-Barajas Airport (MAD); Puerta de Atocha and Chamartín stations are the center of Spain's radial AVE rail network. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Community of Madrid

When visiting cities across Community of Madrid, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Cocido Madrileño
  • Bocadillo de calamares
  • Huevos rotos con jamón
  • Churros con chocolate at San Ginés
  • Vermut de grifo

Best time to visit Community of Madrid

Best time to visit Community of Madrid: Mar–Jun, Sep–Nov.
